ws_testing_policy.title: Testing Policy
values: Cylinders containing inert gases (Nitrogen, Argon, Helium, Neon) stored in climate-controlled locations (Lab A, Lab B) qualify for an extended 7-year hydrostatic testing cycle instead of the standard 5-year cycle.
Cylinders noted as quarantined or scheduled for disposal in the Notes column must be excluded from testing compliance audits.
